paper.title: How Resilient Are Firms’ Financial Reporting Processes?

role_decision.reason: The public repository supplies an unusually strong paper-to-code-to-results pipeline, but the full empirical replication requires WRDS-licensed datasets and an author-provided SPAC dataset. It is therefore suitable for validating LEMON-SCI's scientific-compute compiler architecture, not for freezing a public-data-only one-company ICFR M1 benchmark.

public_or_sec_native_components: SEC 10-K/10-Q filing dates and filing text are conceptually public and the package includes code paths for filing acquisition/parsing.

darwin.define: Find the next executable FT50 benchmark after DGM2007 failed the public-data freeze gate.
alternatives: Rice & Weber (2012) direct ICFR disclosure model
deHaan et al. (2023) public replication package
darwin.retrieve_replicate: Public deHaan package and paper metadata verified; package exposes code, pipeline, variable dictionary, and execution order.
darwin.whole_system_dependencies: Full paper reproduction depends on licensed/proprietary inputs despite public code.
darwin.invalidate_falsify: Public code alone is insufficient to claim end-to-end empirical replication or a public-data-only one-company POC.
darwin.next_evolution: Admit deHaan as compiler-control benchmark; continue direct ICFR benchmark search with Rice & Weber primary-table extraction.
